title: compare_groups: compare a numeric column across groups of a categorical column
description: Group rows by a categorical column and aggregate a numeric column (sum, mean, count, min, max). Returns a sorted comparison table. Use to understand differences between groups.

parameters.name: agg
parameters.description: Aggregation function: sum, mean, count, min, max (default mean).

rag_note: value_column must be numeric. Returns one row per group sorted by the aggregated value descending. Useful for exploratory analysis before deeper filtering or ranking.
